items.description: A route through the world a seat plays as a player would (routes rows): chapters of steps that say where to go and how, played by the seat program the route names (WorldSeatProgram) through the seat's own controls. world.benchmark run <route> plays one in real time and reports each chapter; a chapter fails where a player would see it fail, on a driven contact with a wall or by leaving the places its path crosses.

name.description: The route's name, unique within the document.

program.description: The seat program that plays it.

items.description: One chapter of a WorldRoute: its steps, played in order, and the time it may take.

name.description: The chapter's name, unique within its route; a report addresses the chapter by it.

items.description: One step of a WorldRouteChapter. A place is a region placement's id (place-lobby), the volume body.place answers from; a heading is a yaw in degrees (0 faces -Z, 90 faces -X).

anyOf.description: Sets the seat's body down at a spawn point, or at a point facing a heading (the seat's grant to pose is the world author's).

spawn.description: The spawn point's id, or null for Point.

point.description: The point, or null for Spawn.

yawDegrees.description: The heading a point pose faces.

anyOf.title: WorldRouteStepPoseBody

anyOf.description: Submits one console line as the seat (a view choice, player.camera.view first).
anyOf.title: WorldRouteStepLine

anyOf.description: Travels to a place or a point at a pace. Unless Direct, the path is the navigation domains' route from where the body stands, straightened to the corners a walker turns at and searched again from wherever the body has got to when it strays from it; the places the path crosses are the step's corridor, and standing in none of them fails the chapter. A place is reached on entering it, a point within Within.

place.description: The place, or null for Point.

point.description: The point, or null for Place.

pace.description: The pace, a word the route's program reads (walk, run).

direct.description: Whether the body steers straight at the goal with no navigation (a lift car's floor, a world with no domains), its corridor only Corridor.

within.description: The distance, in metres, at which a point is reached.

corridor.description: Places the body may also stand in on the way.

anyOf.title: WorldRouteStepGo

anyOf.description: Crosses a threshold no navigation domain joins (a portal) or walks where no domain reaches (a world it crossed into): turns the camera onto a heading, then holds the stick straight ahead, as a player walking through does, so a crossing that turns the world's axes carries the walk on through it. It ends on entering a place, or with none after walking a distance.

headingDegrees.description: The heading walked: in the frame of the world the step starts in, or with Relative a turn from the facing the step starts with.

until.description: The place that ends the step, in whichever world the walk reaches, or null to walk Metres.

metres.description: The distance walked, in metres: the whole step with no Until, otherwise the distance past which the step fails short of it. A crossing's jump across the world is no distance walked.

relative.description: Whether HeadingDegrees turns from the step's starting facing.

anyOf.title: WorldRouteStepCross

anyOf.description: Stands for a time, the camera turned onto a heading or toward a point; with neither it holds the facing it has.

lookAt.description: The point looked toward, or null.

anyOf.title: WorldRouteStepRest

anyOf.description: Presses an action where the body stands (the program's button for it), then stands until the body is in a place the world carries it to (a lift arriving) or, with none, for Seconds.

action.description: The action, a word the route's program maps to a button.

until.description: The place that ends the wait, or null.

seconds.description: The time stood after the press with no Until, or the time past which the wait for it fails.

anyOf.title: WorldRouteStepPressAction

items.title: WorldRouteStep

timeoutSeconds.description: The simulated time after which an unfinished chapter fails.

items.title: WorldRouteChapter

margin.description: The clearance, in metres, a straightened path keeps from the edge of the walkable ground on top of the walker's own radius the navigation domains already keep.

items.title: WorldRoute
